entry.title: 16.2.0 Pro — 14 October 2021
entry.content:
• Added support for Vulkan renderer on a Linux host with Intel, Nvidia, and AMD GPUs
  • Added partial support for Windows 11 as host or guest machines[95]
  • Host GPUs that do not support DirectX feature level 11.1 are supported but deprecated[96]
  • Host CPUs that do not support Mode-based Execution Control are supported but deprecated
  • Security updates and bug fixes

entry.title: 16.2.5 Pro — 7 December 2022
entry.content:
• Bug fixes
  • Last version for Windows 8.1 on hosts. Note: If version 16 did not drop Windows 7 support until this version, it would not require Windows 7 users to upgrade to Windows 8 or later.

entry.title: 17.0 Pro — 17 November 2022
entry.content:
• Support for new guest operating systems
    • New Microsoft Windows 11 builds (including Enterprise)
    • Windows Server 2022
    • Ubuntu 22.04
    • RHEL 9
    • Debian 11.x
  • New auto-start virtual machine feature
  • New virtual Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0
  • New full or fast encryption features
  • Support for OpenGL 4.3 and WDDM 1.2
  • Bug fixes

entry.title: 17.0.2 Pro — 25 April 2023
entry.content: • Security updates and bug fixes

entry.title: 17.5 Pro — 19 October 2023
entry.content:
• Support for up to 256 NVMe devices (4 controllers and 64 devices per controller)
  • Support for NVMe 1.3
  • Upgraded encryption algorithm from CBC to XTS
  • New VMRUN command line utility for controlling virtual machines
  • Support for importing or exporting virtual machines with vTPM device
  • Support for managing power operations of encrypted virtual machines using VMREST API
  • Security updates and bug fixes

entry.title: 17.5.1 Pro — 27 February 2024
entry.content: • Fixed CVE-2024-22251 vulnerability

entry.title: 17.5.2 Pro — 14 May 2024
entry.content:
• Copyrights of program now link to Broadcom, VMware LLC's new owner
  • Introduced commercial and personal use subscriptions licensing model. For personal use, a product key won't be required
  • Workstation Player was discontinued as Workstation Pro became free for personal use[15]
  • Fixed CVE-2024-22267, CVE-2024-22268, CVE-2024-22269, and CVE-2024-22270 vulnerabilities
  • Last version for Windows Server 2012 R2 and Windows Server 2016 on hosts

entry.title: 17.6 Pro — 3 September 2024
entry.content:
• Support for new guest operating systems
    • New Microsoft Windows 11 builds (including Enterprise)
    • Windows Server 2025
    • Ubuntu 24.04
    • Fedora 40
  • New vmcli command line utility for directly interacting with the hypervisor from a Linux or macOS terminal, or the Windows command prompt

Removed features:

  • Legacy operating systems Tools ISOs omitted from program download (still available for separate download)
  • Bluetooth hub pass-through
  • Physical parallel port pass-through
  • Unity mode
  • Enhanced keyboard driver

entry.title: Pro 25H2 (25.0.0) — 14 October 2025
entry.content:
• Support for new guest operating systems
    • Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10
    • Fedora 42
    • SUSE Linux Enterprise 16 (Beta)
    • OpenSUSE Leap 16.0 (RC)
    • Debian 13
    • Oracle Linux 10
    • VMware ESX 9.0
  • Support for new host operating systems
    • Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10
    • Fedora Linux 42
    • openSUSE Leap 16.0 (RC)
    • SUSE Linux 16 (Beta)
    • Debian 13
  • USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 controller (up to 20 gbit/s)
  • Update hardware compatibility to version v22
  • Support for Hyper-V/WHP detection
  • New dictTool command line utility for examining and modifying VMware configuration files
